text.박동마다 경동맥 내경을 자동으로 잽니다: Automatic carotid lumen diameter, beat by beat
text.초음파 동영상의 모든 프레임에서 내강을 찾아 내경을 재고, 측정을 믿을: Finds the lumen and measures its diameter in every frame of the ultrasound video, then summarizes the minimum, maximum and change in diameter per beat using only the segments whose measurements are reliable. Scenes that cannot be trusted are listed for review with the reason.
text.DICOM·AVI·WMV. 화면의 환자 정보 영역은 잘라 내고 초음파 영: DICOM, AVI or WMV. The patient information area is cropped out; only the ultrasound region is used.
Lumen segmentation on all frames → diameter per frame → beat detection → reliability check.
Check the summary, then look at the image and calipers only for the scenes on the review list.
text.혈관이 없거나, 횡단면이거나, 경계 확신도가 낮은 장면은 측정하지 않습니: Frames with no vessel, a transverse view or low boundary confidence are not measured.
text.앞뒤 프레임 대비 내경·위치·모양이 생리적 범위보다 빠르게 변하면 탐촉자: If diameter, position or shape changes faster than is physiologically plausible between frames, it is treated as probe motion and excluded.
text.제외 프레임이 많거나 주기·변화량이 다른 박동과 크게 다르면 요약에서 빼: Beats with many excluded frames, or whose period or diameter change differs greatly from the others, are left out of the summary and sent to review.
text.모든 프레임을 분석하고 있습니다. 왼쪽 목록에서 진행률을 볼 수 있고,: All frames are being analyzed. Progress is shown in the list on the left; the result opens automatically when it is ready.
The result opens automatically when it is ready.

text.Carotid lumen diameter · 연구용 소프트웨어 · 진단을: Research software · Not a substitute for diagnosis
Fewer than 2 reliable beats, so no summary is given.
text.측정 방법: 내강 분할 → 혈관 축 가운데 50% 구간의 수직 폭 중앙값: Method: lumen segmentation → median perpendicular width over the central 50% of the vessel axis. Reliability checks: frame (no vessel, transverse view, confidence) · time (abrupt change in diameter, position or shape) · beat (excluded-frame ratio, period, diameter change). Only reliable beats are used in the summary.
